item.skycraft.dragon_claw.hint: Opens a Nordic claw door once its rings show the palm, top to bottom.
message.skycraft.claw_door.locked: The door has a keyhole shaped like a dragon's claw: it wants the %s.
message.skycraft.claw_door.wrong_claw: This claw doesn't fit the keyhole.
message.skycraft.claw_door.rings: The claw won't turn. The rings must show the claw's palm, top to bottom.
message.skycraft.puzzle.wrong: The lever won't budge, and something clicks in the walls...
book.skycraft.dragonstone.intro: A rubbing of the Dragonstone: the burial places of the dragons, as the old priests marked them.
book.skycraft.ustengrav_note.text:
Whoever emptied this pedestal left a scrap of parchment in its place:

"Looking for an old horn? So was I. Riverwood, the inn, the room under the roof. Come alone."
